title: 第二十五章 聚宝阁第二十六章 出名在外身份是自己给的
content_zh:
南元城，聚宝阁。
作为城中最大的交易场所之一，聚宝阁门前车水马龙，人流如织。然而，当一位身披宽大黑袍、身形佝偻的身影缓缓走近时，门口几名气息彪悍的护卫却不由自主地感到一股寒意。
这黑袍人全身笼罩在阴影中，唯一露出的双手布满了密密麻麻、如同老树盘根般的深深刻纹，充满了岁月的沧桑感。他脸上戴着一张做工精致到几乎与真人皮肤无异的人皮面具，面容枯槁，眼神浑浊，任谁看去，都会认为这是一位行将就木的老者。
易容术——千人千面！
楚天舒花费了整整三日，精心炮制了这张人皮面具与配套的手套，将自己十四岁少年的痕迹彻底掩盖。这三日，他足不出户，在那郊外小院中，靠着楚毅笨拙的控火协助，成功炼制出了二十三枚晶莹剔透的冰灵通脉丹。
他一步步走向聚宝阁大门，步伐缓慢而沉稳。当守门的护卫下意识地想要上前盘问，目光对上黑袍下那双看似浑浊、实则深邃如渊的眸子时，一股冰冷刺骨的杀气如同无形的针，瞬间刺入他们的灵魂深处！那是一种仿佛从尸山血海中走出的漠然与死寂，让这几名经历过厮杀的护卫瞬间如坠冰窟，僵立原地，连呼吸都为之停滞，再不敢有丝毫阻拦。
“让你们总管出来，老夫有笔生意想跟他谈谈。”沙哑、苍老，仿佛两块生锈的铁片在摩擦的声音从黑袍下传出。楚天舒运用了改音之术，使得声音与他的外貌完美契合。
护卫首领强压下心中的悸动，不敢怠慢，连忙躬身道：“前辈请稍候，晚辈这就去通传！”
不多时，一位身着锦袍，体型微胖，面容精明的中年男子匆匆从阁内走出，他便是聚宝阁的主管，钱翡南。他脸上堆着职业化的热情笑容，目光却在接触黑袍人的瞬间微微一凝。
‘嗯？灵泽三级？’以他脉络境后期的修为，瞬间感知到了黑袍人外泄的微弱灵力波动，心中不免生出一丝轻视。但当他下意识地对上那双深邃的眼眸时，心脏猛地一缩！那眼神深处，仿佛蕴藏着尸山血海，万千冤魂哀嚎，一种难以言表的沉重压迫感扑面而来，隐隐约约间，他似乎闻到了浓郁的血腥气！这得是杀了多少人，才能凝聚出如此恐怖的杀气？
钱翡南脸上的笑容立刻变得真诚甚至带上了几分敬畏，连忙拱手道：“在下聚宝阁主管钱翡南，不知前辈大驾光临，有失远迎，还望海涵！前辈里面请！”
将楚天舒引至一间装饰奢华、隔音效果极佳的雅间，奉上香茗后，钱翡南才小心翼翼地问道：“阁下光临敝阁，不知是想谈什么生意？”
“丹药。”黑袍下，沙哑的声音言简意赅。
“哦？”钱翡南眼中精光一闪，试探着问道，“阁下是炼药师？”
“以前是……”楚天舒欲言又止，语气中带着一丝恰到好处的落寞与沧桑，仿佛触及了什么不愿回忆的往事。他不再多言，枯槁的手指在黑袍下一抹，取出一枚龙眼大小、通体晶莹如玉的丹药。
丹药出现的瞬间，一股奇异的清香瞬间弥漫在整个雅间。这香气并不浓烈，却带着一种沁人心脾的冰凉感，吸入肺中，竟让人感觉周身灵力运转都似乎顺畅了一丝。丹药表面光滑无比，隐隐有蓝白两色如同水波般的丹晕缓缓流转，核心处似乎有一点灵光若隐若现，宛如活物。
冰灵通脉丹！
钱翡南瞳孔微缩，心中暗惊：‘这药香纯净悠长，丹晕自成，圆润无暇！光是这卖相和气息，怕是已经达到二品丹药的巅峰水准了！甚至……有所超越？’
“此丹，名为通脉丹，位列二品。”楚天舒沙哑的声音缓缓介绍，“功效嘛，可助脉络境修士打通淤塞经脉，辅助突破境界瓶颈，并能稳固突破后的根基。”他顿了顿，语气平淡地抛出一个重磅炸弹，“而且，老夫炼丹时，已特地去除了其中有害的药毒杂质，服用后，基本没有任何副作用。”
钱翡南听着前面两句，虽然觉得这丹药效果卓越，但还在理解范畴之内。然而，当最后那句“基本没有任何副作用”传入耳中时，他脸上的从容瞬间消失，猛地从座位上站了起来，声音都变了调：

“什……什么！无副作用？！”
这简直颠覆了他的认知！身为聚宝阁主管，他太清楚提升境界类丹药的市场了！为什么许多天赋不错的修士不敢大量服用丹药？无非就是两大顽疾：
一是药毒淤积！是药三分毒，再好的丹药，长期服用也会在体内留下杂质丹毒，侵蚀经脉，损伤道基，严重制约未来的修行之路。
二是根基虚浮！依靠丹药之力强行突破，如同沙上筑塔，境界不稳，实力远逊于同阶苦修者，是外强中干的典型。
而眼前这枚丹药，竟然宣称能完美解决这两个问题？！这意味着什么？意味着只要拥有足够的这种丹药，就能像磕糖豆一样，安全无痛地一路突破！这简直是所有修士，尤其是那些卡在瓶颈多年、家底丰厚的大家族子弟梦寐以求的神物！
钱翡南脑海中瞬间闪过无数念头，仿佛已经看到了无数灵石在向他招手。他强行压下心中的激动，声音带着一丝颤抖：“阁下……此言当真？这丹药……可否让在下……验证一番？”
楚天舒似乎早就料到，毫不在意地一挥手，又是两枚同样晶莹剔透的冰灵通脉丹出现在桌上，连同之前那枚，一共三颗，推到了钱翡南面前。那随意的态度，就好像随手丢出了三颗路边捡来的石子，而非足以引起腥风血雨的珍贵灵丹。
“尽管试。”沙哑的声音带着毋庸置疑的自信。
钱翡南深吸一口气，立刻唤来两名心腹手下。这两人都是脉络境一脉的修为，卡在这个境界已经三四年，凭借自身努力几乎看不到突破的希望。
两人将信将疑地服下丹药，盘膝运功。
起初并无异样，但不到一炷香的时间，两人身上几乎同时爆发出强烈的灵力波动！周围天地灵气疯狂地向他们汇聚！他们的脸色先是涨红，随即露出狂喜之色！
半个时辰后，灵力波动缓缓平息。两人睁开双眼，眼中精光四射，激动得难以自持！
“突破了！我突破到二脉了！”
“我也是！感觉困扰多年的壁垒一下子就冲开了！”
“而且……经脉没有任何胀痛不适！反而感觉无比通畅清爽！”
“对对！浑身轻盈，灵力运转快了近一倍，完全没有以往突破后的疲倦和虚浮感！”
两人你一言我一语，兴奋地汇报着感受，看向桌上剩余那枚丹药的眼神，充满了炙热与渴望。
钱翡南看着手下确凿无疑的突破和反馈，眼睛瞪得如同铜铃，心中的震撼无以复加。效果竟然如此显著且迅速！
他猛地想起一人，急匆匆对门外喊道：“快！去将陈执事请来！”

content_en:
Nanyuan City, Jubao Pavilion.
As one of the largest trading places in the city, the front door of Jubao Pavilion is bustling with traffic and people. However, when a hunched figure wearing a wide black robe slowly approached, the guards with strong auras at the door couldn't help but feel a chill.
The whole body of this man in black robes was shrouded in shadow, and the only exposed hands were covered with dense and deep veins like the roots of an old tree, full of the vicissitudes of time. He wore a human skin mask that was so finely crafted that it was almost the same as real skin. His face was haggard and his eyes were cloudy. Anyone who looked at him would think he was a dying old man.
Disguise - Thousands of people with thousands of faces!
Chu Tianshu spent three whole days carefully crafting this human skin mask and matching gloves, completely covering up the traces of his fourteen-year-old self. In the past three days, without leaving home, he successfully refined twenty-three crystal-clear Ice Spirit Channeling Pills in the small courtyard on the outskirts, relying on Chu Yi's clumsy fire control assistance.
He walked towards the gate of Jubao Pavilion step by step, his pace was slow and steady. When the guard guarding the gate subconsciously wanted to step forward to interrogate him, and when his eyes met the seemingly turbid but actually as deep as the abyss eyes under the black robe, a cold and biting murderous aura was like an invisible needle, instantly piercing into the depths of their souls! It was a kind of indifference and dead silence that seemed to come out of a mountain of corpses and a sea of ​​blood. The guards who had experienced fighting instantly felt like they had fallen into an ice cave and stood frozen on the spot. Even their breathing was stagnant, and they did not dare to stop them in the slightest.
"Let your manager come out. I have a business I want to discuss with him." A hoarse, old sound, like two pieces of rusty iron being rubbed, came from under the black robe. Chu Tianshu used the art of voice modification to make his voice perfectly match his appearance.
The guard leader suppressed the throbbing in his heart and did not dare to be negligent. He quickly bowed and said: "Senior, please wait a moment. I will go and pass the message immediately!"
Not long after, a middle-aged man wearing a brocade robe, slightly fat and with a shrewd face hurriedly walked out of the pavilion. He was Qian Feinan, the manager of the Jubao Pavilion. He had a professional and enthusiastic smile on his face, but his eyes froze slightly the moment he came into contact with the man in black robe.
'Um? Lingze Level 3? ’ With his cultivation in the late stage of the Meridian Realm, he instantly sensed the weak spiritual energy fluctuations leaked from the man in black robe, and he couldn’t help but feel a trace of contempt in his heart. But when he subconsciously met those deep eyes, his heart suddenly shrank! In the depths of his eyes, there seemed to be a mountain of corpses and a sea of ​​blood. Thousands of innocent souls were wailing. An indescribable sense of heavy oppression came to his face. Faintly, he seemed to smell the strong smell of blood! How many people must be killed to gather such terrifying murderous intent?
The smile on Qian Feinan's face immediately became sincere and even a little awe-inspiring, and he quickly raised his hands and said: "I'm Qian Feinan, the manager of Jubao Pavilion. I don't know that senior has come to visit me. Although I am disappointed to welcome him from afar, I still hope to see you! Senior, please come in!"
After leading Chu Tianshu to a private room with luxurious decoration and excellent sound insulation, and serving him some fragrant tea, Qian Feinan asked cautiously: "Your Excellency, you are here in my pavilion. What business do you want to discuss?"
"Elixir." Under the black robe, the hoarse voice spoke concisely.
"Oh?" Qian Feinan's eyes flashed and he asked tentatively, "Are you an alchemist?"
"It used to be..." Chu Tianshu hesitated, with a hint of loneliness and vicissitudes in his tone, as if he had touched on something in the past that he didn't want to recall. He said no more, swiped his withered fingers under the black robe, and took out an elixir the size of a dragon's eye, which was as crystal clear as jade.
The moment the elixir appeared, a strange fragrance instantly filled the entire elegant room. The aroma is not strong, but it has a refreshing cold feeling. When inhaled into the lungs, it makes people feel that the spiritual power of the whole body seems to be running smoothly. The surface of the elixir is extremely smooth, with faint blue and white elixir halos flowing slowly like water waves. There seems to be a little spiritual light looming in the core, like a living thing..
Ice Spirit Channeling Pill!
Qian Feinan's pupils shrank, and he was secretly shocked: 'The fragrance of this medicine is pure and long-lasting, the elixir is self-made, and it is round and flawless! Just the appearance and aura alone may have reached the peak level of a second-grade elixir! Even...beyond it? ’
"This pill is called the Tongmai Pill, ranked second grade." Chu Tianshu's hoarse voice slowly introduced, "The effect is that it can help the monks in the Meridian Realm open up blocked meridians, help break through the realm bottleneck, and stabilize the foundation after the breakthrough." He paused and dropped a bombshell in a calm tone, "Moreover, when I made the pill, I had specially removed the harmful poisonous impurities. After taking it, there are basically no side effects."
Qian Feinan listened to the first two sentences. Although he felt that the effect of this elixir was excellent, it was still within the scope of understanding. However, when the last sentence "Basically no side effects" came into his ears, the calmness on his face disappeared instantly, he stood up from his seat suddenly, and his voice changed tone:
"Wha...what! No side effects?!"
This simply subverted his cognition! As the director of Jubao Pavilion, he is very aware of the market for realm-enhancing elixirs! Why do many talented monks dare not take large amounts of pills? There are nothing more than two serious diseases:
One is drug and poison accumulation! This medicine contains three parts of poison. No matter how good the elixir is, if it is taken for a long time, it will leave impurities in the body, corrode the meridians, damage the foundation of the Tao, and seriously restrict future practice.
The second is that the foundation is illusory! Relying on the power of elixirs to force a breakthrough is like building a tower on the sand. The realm is unstable and the strength is far inferior to that of ascetics of the same level. It is a typical example of being strong on the outside but weak on the inside.
And the elixir in front of me actually claims to be able to perfectly solve these two problems? ! what does that mean? It means that as long as you have enough of this elixir, you can break through safely and painlessly like cracking jelly beans! This is simply the fetish that all monks, especially those from big families who have been stuck in the bottleneck for many years and have rich families, dream of!
Countless thoughts flashed through Qian Feinan's mind, as if he had seen countless spiritual stones waving to him. He suppressed the excitement in his heart, and his voice was trembling: "Your Excellency... are you serious about what you said? This elixir... can you please... verify it?"
Chu Tianshu seemed to have expected it, and with a careless wave of his hand, two more crystal-clear Ice Spirit Channeling Pills appeared on the table. Together with the previous one, there were three in total, and they were pushed in front of Qian Feinan. That casual attitude was like throwing away three stones picked up by the roadside, rather than a precious elixir that could cause a bloody storm.
"Just try." The hoarse voice was filled with undoubted confidence.
Qian Feinan took a deep breath and immediately called two of his closest men. Both of them are cultivators of the Meridian Realm. They have been stuck in this realm for three or four years, and there is almost no hope of breakthrough through their own efforts.
The two of them took the elixir hesitantly and crossed their legs to do their exercises.
There was nothing unusual at first, but within less than a moment of burning incense, strong spiritual energy fluctuations erupted from both of them almost at the same time! The spiritual energy of the surrounding world gathered towards them crazily! Their faces turned red at first, and then showed signs of ecstasy!
Half an hour later, the spiritual power fluctuations slowly subsided. The two of them opened their eyes, their eyes were full of light, and they were so excited that they couldn't contain themselves!
"Breakthrough! I broke through to the second meridian!"
"Me too! It feels like the barriers that have been bothering me for so many years are suddenly broken down!"
"And... there is no swelling, pain or discomfort in the meridians! Instead, it feels extremely smooth and refreshing!"
"That's right! My whole body is light, my spiritual energy is running nearly twice as fast, and I don't feel tired or vain after breakthroughs in the past!"
The two of them talked to each other, excitedly reporting their feelings, and their eyes looking at the remaining pill on the table were full of passion and desire.
Qian Feinan looked at the unquestionable breakthrough and feedback from his men, his eyes widened like bells, and he was extremely shocked. The effect is so dramatic and rapid!
He suddenly remembered someone and hurriedly faced the doorShouted: "Quick! Go and invite Deacon Chen!"
